summary: Practise PCA, clustering, classification, and validation in guided Python notebooks. Explore the 10-day course outline.
lede: Multivariate analysis and data mining help analysts investigate datasets with many measures and select methods suited to a defined question. For analysts, researchers, and decision-support professionals, the guided Python work covers data profiling and scaling, PCA and clustering, classification, and cross-validation, with practice interpreting results and documenting limitations through a CRISP-DM workflow.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who work with datasets containing multiple measures and need to choose, run, or review multivariate analyses. It suits foundation-level learners with descriptive statistics experience who want a guided start with Python-based analysis.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of descriptive statistics and spreadsheet use is expected. No prior multivariate analysis or Python programming is required; guided notebooks support running analyses and adjusting selected parameters.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
Data science & machine learning in practice
